story-context.title: Room Roster View
story-context.summary: Build the foundational Room Roster page at /daep/rooms/[roomId] that displays students assigned to a room with period/date selectors. This page is the foundation for all Epic 3 daily operations - Stories 3-2 (Point Entry), 3-3 (Bulk Points), 3-4 (Point Notes), and 3-9 (Attendance) will add columns and functionality.

acceptance-criteria.ac: Shows all students with active placements assigned to this room
Columns: student name, student ID, days remaining, today's points total, attendance status
Room selector dropdown to switch between rooms (for staff assigned to multiple)
Period selector (defaults to current period based on bell schedule)
All DAEP staff can see all rooms (Birdville model; daep_room_staff table preserved for future tenant setting)
District/DAEP admins can see all rooms

files-to-create.file: - getCurrentPeriod(tenantId) - returns current period based on time and bell schedule - getPeriodsForDate(tenantId, date) - returns periods array for date picker - getScheduleForDate(tenantId, date) - checks calendar for schedule overrides

- getUserAccessibleRooms() - returns rooms user can access (all rooms for DAEP roles) - getRoomRoster(roomId, date, period) - main data fetch with students, points, attendance - canAccessRoom(roomId) - authorization check

file.purpose: Color-coded badge (green >10, yellow 5-10, red less than 5)

table.name: daep_rooms
table.description: Room definitions with room_group_id for separation logic
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, room_number, room_name, capacity, active, room_group_id

table.name: daep_room_groups
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, group_name, color, sort_order, active

table.name: daep_room_staff
table.description: Staff-room assignments (not used in Birdville model but preserved)

table.name: daep_bell_schedules
table.description: Bell schedule definitions with periods JSONB
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, schedule_name, periods, is_default, active
table.note: periods is JSONB array: [{period_number, period_name, start_time, end_time}]

table.name: daep_school_calendar
table.description: Calendar with day types and schedule overrides
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, date, is_school_day, day_type, bell_schedule_id, notes

table.name: daep_placements
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, school_id, assigned_room_id, status, days_remaining

table.name: daep_daily_points
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, placement_id, date, period, points_earned
table.note: Empty table - will be populated by Story 3-2

table.name: daep_attendance
table.key-columns: id, tenant_id, placement_id, date, period, status
table.note: Empty table - will be populated by Story 3-9

story-context.roster-query-pattern: SELECT p.id as placement_id, p.school_id, p.days_remaining, p.status, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.grade_level, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(points_earned) FROM daep_daily_points dp WHERE dp.placement_id = p.id AND dp.date = $date), 0 ) as today_points_total, (SELECT status FROM daep_attendance da WHERE da.placement_id = p.id AND da.date = $date AND da.period = $period) as attendance_status FROM daep_placements p JOIN trespass_records t ON t.school_id = p.school_id AND t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = $tenantId AND p.assigned_room_id = $roomId AND p.status IN ('pending', 'active', 'transition') ORDER BY t.last_name, t.first_name;

role-access-model.note: Birdville Model: All DAEP staff see ALL rooms (teachers rotate, students stay in one room)
role-access-model.future-setting: room_access_mode: 'all' | 'assigned' - tenant-level toggle for assigned-room-only mode

existing-patterns.pattern: <Select value={roomFilter} onValueChange={onRoomChange}> <SelectTrigger> <SelectValue placeholder="All Rooms" /> </SelectTrigger> <SelectContent> <SelectItem value="all">All Rooms</SelectItem> {rooms.map((room) => ( <SelectItem key={room.id} value={room.id}> {room.room_number} {room.room_name ? ` - ${room.room_name}` : ''} </SelectItem> ))} </SelectContent> </Select>
From: onDateFromChange(e.target.value)} className="w-36" />

extensibility-requirements.requirement: Create context that stores: current room, date, period, student list, refresh function. Allows child components (added in future stories) to access and modify roster state without prop drilling.
Store column visibility in state to support future stories adding columns.

edge-cases.case: - Before first period: show period 1 - After last period: show last period - Weekends/holidays: show "No school today" - No default schedule configured: show warning with link to settings
- Student assigned to placement but no room yet - Room deactivated while students assigned
- Bell schedule times respect tenant timezone (America/Chicago default) - Date picker uses local date, not UTC
- Large rosters (30+ students) need efficient rendering
